models.name: The Caldwell County Courthouse
models.description: The 1894 Second Empire courthouse in Lockhart, Texas, as a 65 cm LEGO display model on a 45 cm lawn: rough-faced buff stone with red trim, a clock tower on a broad belfry flanked by tall bell domes with round windows on the front and back, crested slate mansards on the four corner pavilions, a balconied entrance and columned side porches. The tower's four clocks really keep time (quartz clock inserts behind the red dials), and its dome lifts off to set them.

models.name: Nautilus
models.description: Captain Nemo's Nautilus from Walt Disney's 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1954) at minifigure scale, 106 cm long: its salon windows are LEGO's biggest clear bubbles. Big tiled side panels on hinges, the toothed crest arch over an alligator-head wheelhouse with bubble eyes, the saw keel, the shark's dorsal fin and the fish tail with its propeller and rudder; the port side of the salon swings up like a gull wing on Captain Nemo's salon - his pipe organ, library, aquarium and crew - and the whole ship rides a breaking sea on two clear posts. The salon lights up, the propeller spins and the rudder swings.
models.notice: The Nautilus design is from Walt Disney's 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea (1954). Unofficial fan model, not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney.

models.name: Nautilus Crew
models.description: Captain Nemo, Ned Land, Professor Aronnax, Conseil and one of Nemo's divers in a brass deep-sea helmet, from 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea, as LEGO minifigures on a slice of the Nautilus's riveted deck in front of a salon window ringed with yellow lights: real printed heads, torsos and legs, a harpoon, a spyglass, a magnifying glass, a specimen bottle and a speargun. A companion to the Nautilus model.
models.notice: Characters from Jules Verne's 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea, as in Walt Disney's 1954 film. Unofficial fan model, not affiliated with or endorsed by Disney.
